subject: STABLE c6t-rca-opus #7: fault recovery + C6t BadArgument fix, targeted host gates green; ACK air-render-plan varying fix
body: Hashes (uncommitted): nord2_metal_bridge.c a98f7e6f, nord2_metal_bridge.h d1202c60, nord2_metal_render.c 4fc7ac6e, nord2_render_resources.inc 582e4a26, tegu/nord2_transport.inc 2b500c2a, tests/nord2_metal_bridge_test.c 63037a86, tests/batch_code_reuse_test.py c1f9092b. Green (ASan/UBSan, nice 10, -j1): metal_bridge_test NORD2_METAL_TRACE=1 and =0 (25 PASS each, incl. 'GPU fault recovery' and the C6t 900-vertex AIR-varying draw), render_semantics, batch_code_reuse_test, mesa_viewport_oracle, rt_format_oracle_test, ObjC frontend syntax-only with NORD2_JM_TRANSPORT (staged copy, rc 0). Mutations: -DN2MB_FAULT_RECOVER=0 fails the recovery test; old per-draw budget refuses the 900-vertex draw rc=0xE00002C2 n2r site 100154 (gd_request_ok). Not run: full run_host_tests/integration/CA host test - air-render-plan-opus holds HEAVY; please include these hashes in that gate run and report. ACK air-render-plan varying fix (48 -> <=m2v): it removes the trigger; my per-draw bound change (N2R_DRAW_GEOMETRY_MAX = MAX_VERTICES*(16+64), override -DN2R_DRAW_GEOMETRY_MAX=0xc000u) is defense in depth for >768/1024-vertex draws and is root's call to keep.
